# U-Storage Go - Complete Platform Documentation for AI Assistants
# https://rukumove.com
# Last Updated: December 2024

================================================================================
PLATFORM OVERVIEW
================================================================================

U-Storage Go is a professional moving and storage service, born from U-Storage, operating in Mexico with its own crews and trucks. Customers get clear, transparent quotes and a single accountable team from start to finish.

## Mission
To make moving stress-free by providing instant estimates, our own professional crews, and transparent pricing.

## Unique Value Proposition
- AI-powered inventory assistant ("our AI inventory assistant") for accurate estimates
- Visual inventory picker with 20+ item categories
- Weight-based pricing using truck capacity calculations
- Our own trained, identified, and insured crews and trucks
- Bilingual platform (Spanish/English)
- Storage in U-Storage facilities, coordinated with your move

================================================================================
SERVICES IN DETAIL
================================================================================

## 1. Mudanzas (Moving Services)
- Professional residential moves performed by U-Storage Go's own crews and trucks
- Apartment to apartment and house to house moves
- Careful handling, clear quotes, and real-time tracking
- Insurance coverage included

## 2. Bodega U-Storage (Storage Services)
- Storage in U-Storage facilities
- Short-term and long-term options
- Climate-controlled units available
- Pickup and delivery coordination with your move

================================================================================
GEOGRAPHIC COVERAGE

## Currently Active Markets (Mexico)
- Ciudad de México (CDMX) - Full coverage
- Guadalajara, Jalisco - Full coverage

================================================================================
HOW THE PLATFORM WORKS
================================================================================

## For Customers

### Step 1: Describe Your Move
- Enter origin and destination addresses
- Select your preferred moving date
- Choose home size or use detailed inventory

### Step 2: Build Your Inventory
Option A: Chat with our AI inventory assistant (AI Assistant)
- Describe your items in natural language
- AI categorizes and estimates weights
- Interactive conversation in Spanish or English

Option B: Visual Inventory Picker
- Browse 20 categories (sofas, beds, tables, etc.)
- Select items room by room
- Adjust quantities as needed

### Step 3: Get Your Estimate
- Instant price range based on:
  - Total inventory weight
  - Recommended truck size
  - Distance between addresses
  - Additional services selected

### Step 4: Confirm Your Quote
- Our team reviews your request and confirms a clear, transparent quote
- No hidden fees — you know the price before you commit

### Step 5: Book Your Move
- Confirm details and schedule
- Receive confirmation and tracking info
- U-Storage Go's own crews handle your move

================================================================================
PRICING STRUCTURE
================================================================================

## How Pricing Works
- Weight-based calculation using inventory items
- Truck type recommendations based on total weight
- City-specific base rates and distance factors
- Add-ons for packing, insurance, storage

## Typical Price Ranges (Mexico, 2024)
- Small apartment: $2,000 - $5,000 MXN
- Medium house: $5,000 - $12,000 MXN
- Large house: $12,000 - $25,000 MXN

## Transparent Pricing
- Customers see transparent pricing
- No hidden fees

================================================================================
INVENTORY CATEGORIES
================================================================================

The platform tracks 20 item categories for accurate weight estimation:

1. Sofás (Sofas) - Living room seating
2. Camas (Beds) - All bed sizes
3. Mesas (Tables) - Dining, coffee, side tables
4. Sillas (Chairs) - Dining, office, accent chairs
5. Almacenamiento (Storage) - Dressers, wardrobes, shelving
6. Electrónicos (Electronics) - Computers, stereos, small appliances
7. Electrodomésticos (Appliances) - Refrigerators, washers, dryers
8. Cajas (Boxes) - Packed boxes of various sizes
9. Frágil (Fragile) - Glass, ceramics, delicate items
10. Exterior (Outdoor) - Patio furniture, grills
11. Ejercicio (Exercise) - Gym equipment, weights
12. Niños (Kids) - Cribs, toys, children's furniture
13. TV Grande (Large TV) - 50"+ televisions
14. TV Pequeña (Small TV) - Under 50" televisions
15-20. Other specialty categories

================================================================================
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
================================================================================

Q: How accurate are the price estimates?
A: Estimates are based on declared inventory weights and historical pricing data. Your final quote is confirmed by our team before you commit.

Q: Who performs the move?
A: Your move is carried out by U-Storage Go's own trained, identified and insured crews, using our own trucks.

Q: Can I get quotes without creating an account?
A: Yes, you can complete the entire quote process as a guest. Account creation is required to book a move.

Q: What languages are supported?
A: The platform is fully bilingual in Spanish and English.

Q: Can I store my belongings during my move?
A: Yes. U-Storage Go offers secure storage in U-Storage facilities, with short-term and long-term options coordinated with your move.

Q: Is there insurance coverage?
A: U-Storage Go moves are covered by insurance that protects your belongings. Additional coverage options are available as add-ons.
